summary: Legally binding change of personal name published in the Official Government Gazette for passport and educational records.

steps.title: Sworn name change affidavit
steps.description: Execute affidavit before Judicial Magistrate or Notary stating old name, new name, and father's name.

steps.title: Publish newspaper advertisements
steps.description: Publish short name change notice in two prominent local daily newspapers (one English, one Hindi/regional).

steps.title: Prepare Gazette Proforma & CD
steps.description: Draft official proforma and burn MS Word soft copy onto a compact disc (CD).

steps.title: Submit dossier to Controller of Publications
steps.description: Submit complete file with fee receipt via registered post or at Civil Lines Delhi counter.

steps.title: Download e-Gazette notification
steps.description: Download published Gazette notification from egazette.gov.in to update Passport, Aadhaar, and Bank.
